static_traits.name: Chen Kai
static_traits.family_status: Living with spouse; has ten nieces and nephews
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive spouse and several writer friends; marriage affected by emotional fluctuations and insufficient confidence; living in the New York City writing circle.
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past or counseling.
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, able to describe internal experience and self-Reflect; calm tone, highly cooperative; able to recall trigger situations and automatic thoughts concretely.

basic_info.main_problem: 'I believe anything I write will never be published', this thought brings doubt, Anxiety, and Fear of failure.
basic_info.core_demands: Hopes to be more confident in writing and reduce the fear of rejection; because the growing fear affects body, mind, and writing motivation, seeks counseling for improvement.
growth_experiences: Years ago within a short time experienced repeated rejections from publishers and literary agents; initial pressure moderate, then gradually worsening after each submission failure. This experience formed and reinforced the belief that 'what I write will not be published'. Anxiety and doubt appear when starting new drafts or thinking of submissions; to cope, at that stage tried improving writing skills, seeking peer feedback, attending writing workshops, but the overall Fear kept worsening.

Early in the writing career also experienced rejection and Self-doubt; coping then included: temporarily pausing writing to regulate, proactively seeking feedback and repeatedly revising works. Never received professional psychotherapy.

special_situations.event: A few years ago, received rejection letters from publishers and agents in quick succession within a short time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my work is Being rejected, it means I lack ability and will never be published
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: On one hand doubling down on improving writing skills, attending writing workshops and seeking feedback; on the other hand Procrastination and avoidance when facing submissions to reduce the chance of rejection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This proves I am no good; no one will ever want to publish my work

special_situations.event: When editing or preparing to submit a manuscript
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If a work still needs revision, it means it is simply not good enough, and that I as an author am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly polishing details, harsh self-evaluation seeking 'zero mistakes'; while delaying submission to temporarily ease Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is not good enough; no publisher will want it

special_situations.event: Hearing other Writers get publication news
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others can publish while I cannot, it means I am worse than them and can never catch up in the future
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces situations of comparing with peers and avoids social topics involving submissions to evade being compared; directs energy toward self-criticism rather than realistic attempts
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never compare to them

special_situations.event: Receiving constructive revision suggestions from peers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If much revision is needed, it means the work is hopeless overall, and future works will not be good either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tends to give up or greatly delay revision to avoid facing further evidence of failure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This piece will never be published; all my works are not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen, recognized, and published (accepted and affirmed)
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and Being rejected, worrying about being judged not good enough, Impaired self-esteem, relationships affected
defense_goal: Reducing the pain of Being rejected through Self-deprecation and avoiding submission
Keeps distance with rationalized reasons to avoid being set back again

object_relations.self_representation: I am someone whose relationships are affected by emotional fluctuations and Self-doubt
object_relations.object_representation: Spouse is supportive but burdened by me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When in counseling reviewing rejections from publishers/agents or discussing peers' constructive feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Experiencing outside criticism or suggestions as overall negation of self-worth (transference: imagining publishers/reviewers as harsh rejecters)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a self-blaming and self-deprecating tone (e.g. 'it is all I am not good enough'), lowering focus on others, turning emotions inward.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor invites a more balanced analysis of the evidence or suggests a behavioral experiment (such as continuing to submit work)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worrying new attempts will fail again and bring shame or negation
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Declining to try with rational, objective data or industry difficulties as reasons (such as 'the industry is too hard, the probability too low'), tone restrained, listing facts to support avoidance.

manifestations: Repeated rejection experiences reinforced the 'will never be published' belief, weakening the sense of meaning and achievement expectations in writing
Decreased drive, more procrastination, Decreased focus and productivity, Sleep affected
outcomes: Increased Anxiety and Fear of failure
Impaired occupational functioning and tense Marriage and relationships

manifestations: At critical choice points of submission and revision, bound by the fear of failure, reducing attempts and submissions
Temporarily relieving Anxiety through Procrastination and avoidance, limiting autonomous choice and action
outcomes: Worsening avoidance and procrastination, fewer opportunities

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequently using Self-denial statements when talking about writing and submissions (e.g. 'this is not good enough')
Excessively demands 'perfection' for feedback and revisions before allowing submission

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Assuming 'no publisher will want this' without verification yet, externally attributing inner lack of confidence as others' rejection
When hearing others' publication news, automatically thinking 'I will never compare to them'

positive_force: Has a supportive spouse and several writer friends, able to provide emotional support and peer perspective
Once proactively adopted strategies (improving writing skills, seeking feedback, attending workshops, revising works) to cope with setbacks
Willing to seek counseling and try new cognitive and behavioral methods
negative_force: Catastrophizing, mental filtering, and 'predicting the future' thinking reinforcing the failure script
Intense fear of failure and rejection, leading to procrastination and avoidance of submitting work
Self-worth over-tied to work performance, Worsened self-negation
Sleep impaired, Decreased concentration and lowered productivity, further weakening self-efficacy
After comparing with others, feels inferior; relationships and emotions negatively affected

target_behavior.behavior: Procrastination and avoidance before submitting and revising
antecedent: When entering the editing phase or preparing to submit work
When hearing news of peers' publications or successes
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic prediction of Being rejected and failure plus the 'I am not good enough' core belief driving Anxiety and avoidance
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential negative evaluation and failure outcomes, reducing Anxiety and shame in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Declining writing and submission frequency, Impaired occupational functioning; lower Self-efficacy; further reinforcing negative beliefs

target_behavior.behavior: Writing-related Anxious Sleep impaired (Difficulty falling asleep/Declining sleep quality)
antecedent: The night before thinking about submitting a manuscript
target_behavior.core_reason: Negative predictions of future outcomes and repeated worry raising physiological arousal
target_behavior.function: No direct function (discomfort maintained); in the short term seeking control through thinking 'preparing in advance'
target_behavior.consequence: Energy drops the next day, concentration and productivity decrease, forming a vicious cycle
